english: Open Service Applications, select one application and choose Review and Decide. Approve only when all evidence and verification requirements pass. For missing information, choose Request Information, select the exact fields or documents and explain what is needed. The clinician responds from the application details in a focused dialog. New license files appear under Professional License; original snapshots remain in history. Reject with a meaningful reason when requirements are not met.

A clinician can request assistance from onboarding or Service Applications. Open Email-Assisted Applications, enter only clinician-supplied details and save the draft. Record the private email authorization, received date, source reference and separate declarations before submitting. Assisted entry never verifies a license or approves a service or language. Identification remains restricted to assigned credential reviewers.
